description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three different models across various evaluation datasets and their average. The horizontal axis displays the categorical evaluation datasets in the following order: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the numerical score; it lacks an explicit axis line, label, or tick marks, but the bar heights correspond to a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.00 based on the provided data labels. The chart features three bars per category arranged side-by-side. According to the legend at the bottom, the dark blue bar corresponds to a redacted or obscured label, the light blue bar represents "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and the light grey bar represents "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)". Every bar is visually emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it. Across all categories, the light grey "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" bar consistently has a value of 1.00, making it the tallest bar in every group. The dark blue bars represent the lowest values in each group, with the shortest overall being 0.42 in the PT-EVAL category and the tallest being 0.71 in the KoBEST-CP category. The light blue "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" bars fall in the middle of each group, ranging from a low of 0.46 in PT-EVAL to a high of 0.74 in KoBEST-CP. For the AVG category, the dark blue bar is 0.57, the light blue bar is 0.61, and the light grey bar is 1.00. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted by value.
